subject.title: [Bug]: tools.elevated.enabled: true breaks exec routing logic (tools.

question: Should allowed elevated sessions with no explicit `agents.defaults.elevatedDefault` default to `off`, and should `/elevated ask` remain a host-with-approval alias or become sandbox-by-default per-call opt-in elevation?
rationale: The narrow safer default changes upgrade behavior, while changing `/elevated ask` would redefine a documented sandbox escape contract; automation should not choose that security boundary alone.

options.title: Default implicit elevation off
options.body: Change only the no-explicit-default fallback to `off`, preserve `/elevated ask` as the documented host-with-approval alias, and update docs/tests for the safer default.

options.title: Redefine ask as opt-in
options.body: Make `/elevated ask` keep normal exec in the sandbox and route only explicit elevated calls to host approval, accepting the broader behavior-contract change.

options.title: Keep current behavior
options.body: Leave elevated enabled as session-level host exec by default and close this only after docs make that security posture unmistakable.

recommendation.title: Default implicit elevation off
recommendation.body: Change only the no-explicit-default fallback to `off`, preserve `/elevated ask` as the documented host-with-approval alias, and update docs/tests for the safer default.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history for elevated mode semantics, exec target routing, and the current docs contract points to steipete.
